failure: Failure: No efficient algorithm or polynomial presentation-time guarantee follows. The conditional rounding theorem does not itself produce rho or prove the energy gap for an arbitrary group. Compact/Haar extensions are unnecessary and are not part of the stated proof.
interface: Interface: An exact finite-dimensional representation rho and a uniform mixed-copy energy gap are supplied hypotheses. The original permutation matrices are compared with the representation in normalized Frobenius square. d_h counts added labels in the denominator N; no compact-group or Haar-selection step is used.

claims.title: A mixed-copy energy gap gives a charged exact permutation action from a supplied finite-dimensional unitary representation
